For every claim you attribute to a source, write one line in exactly this form:
SOURCE: <full URL> | QUOTE: "<a sentence copied word-for-word from that page>" | CLAIM: <what you take it to show>

response.content:
I could not find an official statement from the Raspberry Pi Foundation or Raspberry Pi Ltd that specifies an exact duration or end date for the Raspberry Pi 5's production run. 

While the company has frequently discussed their commitment to long-term production for the Raspberry Pi product line in general—as well as specific minimum production guarantees for their compute modules and industrial customers—they have not published a defined production lifespan guarantee specifically for the Raspberry Pi 5 single-board computer.
